text: Accounting is a discipline that studies the measurement, recording, analysis and supervision of economic activities. It is hailed as "the language of business". Through a set of systematic methods (such as double-entry bookkeeping and financial statement preparation), it converts the economic behaviors of enterprises, governments or organizations into quantifiable information, providing a basis for decision-making. Whether it is the analysis of enterprise profits, the government's fiscal budget, or personal financial planning, all rely on the logic and tools of accounting.
